name: 21227 · Baltimore, MD
findings: ZIP 21227 (Baltimore) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21227 (Baltimore) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
